messages:
maria: Heads up — since the RBAC policy push at 09:12 we've seen a 3x spike in TLS handshake failures hitting apac-edge. errors look like KMS decrypt denies when the proxy tries to unwrap ephemeral client certs.

sam: ugh. which policy changed? the rotator or the keystore read role?

maria: keystore-read role got tightened (removed s3:GetObject on rotator-service). suspect rotator couldn't fetch intermediate that the proxy expects. logs: 
```
2024-03-12T09:14:02Z proxy[ingress]: tls_handshake_error: unwrap_kms_failed: AccessDenied: User is not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt
    resource: arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-1:xxxx:key/aaaa
    principal: rotator-service@redwood
```

akiko: if it's KMS decrypt, tightening keystore s3 perms wouldn't cause that unless rotator's role change also removed kms:Decrypt. Did the IAM role update bundle both?

maria: yes — infra PR was a bundled change to roles. I can see the kms:Decrypt permission was removed in the new role policy doc.

leo: reaction :facepalm: — immediate mitigation?

sam: temporary rollback of the role change for rotator only. we can reapply stricter tags once we verify no handshake fallout.

maria: I'm +1 for rollback. also recommend enabling verbose mTLS error logging on a small set of proxies to capture SNI and cert fingerprint so we can correlate which services are impacted.

ops-bot: incident created: INC-2024-0412 (apac-edge tls-handshake-spike). incident commander assigned: sam.

sam: i'll roll the role back to previous version in ap-southeast-1 now. ping when logs show decreases.

(2 minutes pass)

maria: rollback applied. tailing logs now. initial handshake failures dropped ~80% in apac-edge within 3m. still seeing ~20% left but different error: 
```
2024-03-12T09:18:45Z proxy[ingress]: tls_handshake_error: sni_mismatch: expected="svc-a.internal" got="svc-a.eu.internal"
```

akiko: that looks like SNI routing hitting cross-region certs. Could be caching/replication lag of keystore entries after the rotator restarted. Are we seeing stale keystore replicas in edge zones?

maria: yes — keystore replication event stream shows backlog for apac region for ~6min after the rotator restart. some proxies served old certchain leading to handshake mismatch.

leo: for the remaining 20% we should implement two short-term mitigations: 1) a tolerant SNI acceptor mode on proxies that will accept alternate SANs for 5m window; 2) keep a short-lived fallback cert in the local keystore that proxies check if primary fails.

sam: tolerant mode sounds risky but OK as a 5-minute mitigation while we reconcile replicas. need audit log flags toggled so we can track when it's used.

maria: agreed — enable tolerant mode on 10% of proxies first and ensure we log: sni_accept_fallback=true, matched_san list, and keystore_version. Add KQL query to surface those events.

akiko: also we should update our incident runbook: add step to verify kms:Decrypt scope when changing any role that touches rotator or proxy keystores. This RBAC tightening got applied without that cross-check.

sam: logging snippet i want in audit logs when fallback used: 
```
{ "event": "sni_fallback", "proxy": "apac-edge-03", "client_sni": "svc-a.eu.internal", "matched_cert_sans": ["svc-a.internal","svc-a.eu.internal"], "keystore_version": "v2024-03-12-0910", "operation_id": "op-9a7b" }
```

maria: tagging ops-sre and compliance for audit retention questions. compliance: how long do we need to keep these extra fallback audit events?

akiko: compliance: fallback events must be retained 1 year for regulated customers, but we can set internal retention to 90 days. create an audit policy entry and notify customers if they were impacted.

leo: action items I captured: 
- sam: role rollback done and monitor until 09:40.
- maria: enable tolerant mode on 10% proxies and enable sni_fallback audit logging.
- akiko: update runbook and IAM preflight checklist to include kms:Decrypt verification.
- sam: open PR to split role bundle (rotator-only) to avoid sweeping changes.
- maria: verify keystore replication metrics and run a reconciliation job if backlog > 2m.

maria: one more thing — let's also add a KMS access smoke test into the rotator deploy pipeline: after role apply, call kms:Decrypt on a test wrapping key and assert success before switching the rotator. saves us from this class of outage.

akiko: +1 for preflight. add a test step that runs in all regions where the rotator is deployed.

ops-bot: update: INC-2024-0412 severity downgraded to P2 at 09:36 (service impact limited, mitigations active).

sam: will follow up with a post-incident summary and timeline. thanks team. :thumbsup:

maria: filing the postmortem draft in #postmortems and will include the audit queries, logs, and the IAM diff that caused this.

leo: closing loop — make sure the follow-up includes an owners list for keystore role changes and a mandatory runbook signoff for infra PRs that touch kms or keystore roles.
